pageshim.login_message: Sign in to LinkedIn, then return here.

refresh_policy.rationale: LinkedIn aggressively blocks automated access; profile refresh is manual-only.

display.label: Your LinkedIn profile
display.detail: Name, headline, summary, location, industry, current position, URL.

connection_count.description: Owner-bound connectionsSummary.numConnections, independent of connection enumeration. Falls back to the walked distinct connection count with a diagnostic when the summary is unavailable or fails owner validation; the fallback does not prove inventory completeness.

profile_picture_url.description: Dash profile's own display image, falling back to /me's miniProfile picture. Null when neither is present.

display.label: Your work experience
display.detail: Title, company, start/end dates, location, description per role.

start_date.description: Partial date at source precision: YYYY or YYYY-MM (LinkedIn never reports day precision for experience).

end_date.description: Partial date at source precision: YYYY or YYYY-MM. Null means the role is current.

display.label: Your education
display.detail: School, degree, field of study, start/end dates.

start_date.description: Partial date at source precision: YYYY or YYYY-MM.

end_date.description: Partial date at source precision: YYYY or YYYY-MM. Null means ongoing.

logo_url.description: School logo image. Null when the source shape (any of school.logo.vectorImage, the typed com.linkedin.common.VectorImage key, or the older schoolLogo.vectorImage) is absent.

display.label: Your skills
display.detail: Skill names plus endorsement counts if visible.

display.label: Your languages
display.detail: Language name plus proficiency level, if visible.

display.label: Your connections
display.detail: Name, headline, profile URL, and date connected.
